rachel_sales: FYI Evergreen is asking for our SOC 2 Type II and wants a bridge letter + sample evidence for their vendor review. They said procurement won't greenlight the POC without something today.

devin_se: Quick context 101 101 POC target is Dedicated infra for 45 days then evaluate Private. They listed SIG questions around auth, encryption, and incident notif.

marie_security: We have a short SOC2 bridge letter template that covers report period and scope. Its unilateral from Redwood and is usually accepted for short procurement holds. Can confirm whether they need mutual countersign first.

corey_legal: If they require countersignature we need to run the mutual language (48 hrs). Unilateral bridge letter is fine and low risk; we'll sign on company letterhead. If they want an NDA before viewing redacted evidence, we can push a fast-track mutual NDA via DocuSign.

rachel_sales: Evergreen asked if the bridge letter can explicitly reference Dedicated and Dedicated-only controls, and whether Private deployment would be covered later.

marie_security: Answer: Bridge letter can explicitly call out that controls apply to Hosted and Dedicated environments. Private (customer-managed) is excluded unless we have a separate Private SOC addendum. We'll add that clause.

evergreen_cto: Also, can we get a one-page CAIQ-lite and a walkthrough call with your security engineer? We want to tick off a handful of high-risk items quickly.

devin_se: We can do CAIQ-lite + 30m call. For evidence sharing we prefer secure portal link for a single reviewer for 48-72h. That requires NDA + reviewer email. We cannot share raw audit workpapers.

corey_legal: NDA link (mutual): https://redwood.example/docusign/mutual-nda. If they sign, legal will attach DocuSign ID to deal docs and ops can provision access.

ops-bot: ASSET: SOC2-compact.pdf (redacted) uploaded to secure vault id:v4c7. Visibility: internal until NDA execution.

marie_security: CAIQ-lite (highlights) I'll drop here after legal confirms bridge wording:
``
- Auth: SSO + MFA required; RBAC enforced
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit
- KMS: Redwood-managed by default; customer KMS supported for Dedicated
- IR: 24/7 on-call; legal notif for material incidents within 72 hrs
- Logging: redacted snapshots available; no raw PII or logs shared
```

devin_se: Workflow to provision reviewer access: 1) NDA executed 2) share reviewer email 3) ops ticket opened -> 48-72h read-only link created. I'll own the ticket.

rachel_sales: Proposed timeline to Evergreen: sign NDA today -> bridge letter + portal link within 24 hours; CAIQ-lite + 30m call within 48 hours.

evergreen_cto: We'll sign NDA now and send reviewer email. One last ask: can bridge letter include a named IR contact (email + phone)?

marie_security: Yes, we'll include security@redwood.ai and escalation phone.

corey_legal: Noted. If they ask for countersign, flag now so we can start review.

rachel_sales: Sending NDA link and asking for reviewer contact. Will update thread on signature. :thumbsup:
